query: Which synthetic drift generators (style-transfer, geometry/lighting perturbations, sensor noise, physics-based simulators) will we include and what metrics quantify their ecological realism versus natural drift?

response.query: Which synthetic drift generators (style-transfer, geometry/lighting perturbations, sensor noise, physics-based simulators) will we include and what metrics quantify their ecological realism versus natural drift?
response.answer: We will include style-transfer, geometry/lighting perturbations, and physics-based simulators. Metrics for ecological realism include accuracy of environmental simulation and fidelity to natural drift patterns.

And last and foremost, to Laura Rutjes-Weurding, my wife, you know :) 252 Summary This thesis has two research topics, ’the problem of lightning initiation’ and ’high energy radiation from thunderstorms and lightning’. After the ﬁrst initiation phase, lightning develops further and can produce ﬂashes of high energy radiation, in so-called terrestrial gamma-ray ﬂashes (TGFs), including the emission of neutrons.
